g.text: your friend looks up the ip

svg.text: you send your friend the link

g.text: Your friend opens the Tailscale address to call you on
Jitsi Meet. The phone looks the name up in the DNS
phonebook and gets the address it points to, then goes
through the internet, Tailscale's relay and the tunnel to
your SelfPrivacy server, and the call comes back the same
action — you do this, to that
at a company you depend on (Cloudflare, Tailscale, DuckDNS…)
free & in your own hands (e.g. your router)
